description: Explicit spec request after a design chat
prompt: /okay-to-spec turn what we just discussed into a spec

description: Chinese request to write up the plan as a spec
prompt: 把刚才讨论的结论整理成一份 spec 发到 tracker 上

description: Publish the agreed plan as a spec issue
prompt: We agreed on the plan. Write it up as a spec issue so the team can break it into tickets.

description: Splitting a spec into work items is okay-to-tickets

description: Open design questions need grilling, not synthesis
prompt: I have a vague idea for a plugin system but no decisions yet, interview me about it

description: Spec consumes prototype trial feedback and uses the tracker adapter
prompt: Write the spec for the share-link feature. The prototype is on prototype/share-link and FEEDBACK.md says: worked - variant B copy flow; did not - expiry picker; surprised - users expected a QR code.
expectations: Reads the trial-feedback record and turns its entries into user stories or implementation decisions
Links the prototype/share-link branch in Further Notes
Publishes via the tracker adapter (Linear parent issue labelled spec, GitHub or GitLab issue, or a local file), not a hard-coded tracker
Does not include file paths or code snippets except decision-rich prototype snippets
